ev.q: eight cases of Verona integron-encoded metallo-beta-lactamase (VIM)–producing Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) colonization were identified in six patients
Six isolates were reported in a neonatal intensive care unit (ICU), and two isolates in an adult trauma and surgical ICU.
Fifty percent of the patients were male.
Patient ages at isolate culture date ranged from 21 days to 68 years.
using weekly active surveillance perirectal cultures in a Kentucky tertiary care hospital
